lines.t: Lord, I want to come to you To feel your love so true
A love that makes me feel the joy
A joy so strong
It never fades, it never slumbers
It never goes away
I want to come to you, Lord
And be filled with this joy
a joy that seeps into the innermost parts crafted by your fingertips a joy that causes
words of praise to you to forever be on my lips
All I want is to feel the joy of you
All I want is to feel your love
Love that surpasses time and space
Love found in every place
Love cleansing every heart
A love that will never depart
A place of perfect peace
A wonderful world of love
Love and joy from above
Lord, I know I was never alone
That to you I was never unknown
You are with me and in me
You are the blood of my veins
The salt of my tears
Healing wounds
Washing away my fears
You said, oh my beloved
Let me wipe them away, even everyone
Numbering them, accounting them
Unto love's purpose
Lord, I'll gladly let you
All I want is to feel your love
To feel this joy from above
You are the fulfillment of all things
The bright light shining on the cloudy day
In your arms heaven and earth pass away
Perfect fulfillment remains
United to you in love
A perfect love
A love that brings forth a perfect joy
A feeling only you can employ
I love you.
We'll be right back.
Thank you for watching.
